summary: Frontend-only verification of Analytics Pelanggan at 390x844. The compact dashboard loaded, stayed within the viewport, updated from Sep 2026 to Agu 2026, preserved region and segment feedback, and kept charts, legends, insights, and fixed navigation visible.
critical_code_review_comments: Local sample analytics data is intentionally MOCKED per request; no backend API is wired.
The rolling trend correctly contains five points for the Aug 2026 selection; a test assertion expecting six points would be incorrect.
seed_data_creation: None; existing local sample snapshots were used.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified at https://ummu-bos-app.preview.emergentagent.com with 390x844. Period selector, region Makassar feedback, segment Loyal feedback, all five segment rows, all six region rows, chart hit targets available for the selected rolling range, fixed Analytics navigation, no horizontal overflow, and no DOM error overlay were checked. The automation stopped only because it incorrectly required trend-point-5 after switching to Aug 2026; the screenshot showed the valid five points 0-4.
rca_of_issue: No product defect reproduced. The only failed automation assertion was a test-design error: getAnalytics('2026-08') returns monthKeys.slice(1, 5), yielding five points (Apr-Aug), not six.
